_comment: Create these secrets in AWS Secrets Manager before deploying. Replace all values with your real credentials. Secret names must match exactly — the task definitions reference them by ARN suffix.

secrets.name: kiosk/clerk-secret-key
secrets.description: Clerk server-side secret key — starts with sk_

secrets.name: kiosk/clerk-publishable-key
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key — starts with pk_. Also used as NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in frontend.

secrets.name: kiosk/api-url
secrets.description: Public URL of the api-server, used by the frontend to make API calls

secrets.name: kiosk/mcp-base-url
secrets.description: Public base URL of the MCP server, used by api-server (to build mcpEndpoint) and frontend (to display the URL)
